title: Scoring utilities (minBookRate, compositeScore, chainScore, driverFit, CPM)
description: Implement all five scoring utility functions as pure functions with no side effects. These are consumed by the load-intelligence feature at runtime. TDD approach: write tests from the PRD formulas and success criteria first. See TDD §8 for implementations, PRD §Capabilities for formulas. All files in hussle-app-dispatch-api/src/shared/scoring/.
acceptanceCriteria: calculateMinBookRate({ vehicleCpm, totalMiles, feePercent, profitMargin }) returns number rounded up to nearest $50
GIVEN vehicleCPM=$0.85, totalMiles=800, feePercent=10%, profitMargin=0.15 THEN returns 900
calculateCpm(expenses[]) returns cost-per-mile as number from vehicle expense breakdown
calculateCompositeScore returns { cpmPoints (0-40), marketPoints (0-30), driverFitPoints (0-30), compositeScore (0-100), scoreType ('full'|'route'), compositeLabel }
Composite score 'full' mode: all three dimensions scored with rate data. 'route' mode: cpmPoints=0, only market + driverFit scored (max 60)
Score labels: >=85 'Excellent', >=65 'Good', >=40 'Fair', <40 'Poor' (for full mode). Route mode labels: >=50 'Excellent', >=35 'Good', >=20 'Fair', <20 'Poor'

calculateDriverFit({ preferredLanes, noGoZones, homeBase, destination, maxDaysOut, currentDaysOut, milesFromHome }) returns { isPreferredLane, isNoGoZone, milesFromHome, daysFromHome, exceedsMaxDaysOut, points (0-30) }
Driver fit: preferred lane match = 30pts, no-go zone = 0pts, distance-based scoring for non-matching
calculateChainScore matches TDD §8.3 exactly: Chain Profitability (0-40) + Return Positioning (0-35) + Time Efficiency (0-25) = 0-100
Chain metrics include: roundTripRevenue, roundTripProfit, chainRPM, dailyRevenueUtilization, projectedWeeklyGross
All scoring functions are pure (no side effects, no Redis/DB calls)
All test cases pass before implementation code is written (TDD RED phase)
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest --coverage src/shared/scoring && npx tsc --noEmit
